card.name: Words just before absorption or exposure
card.fires_on: Words that come just before an expected quantity or exposure term, such as 'increase the <<total>> systemic exposure' or 'result in <<increased>> absorption'. It also fires on a space before a number in news text.

modes.label: Before exposure or absorption
modes.description: Linking or modifier word that leads into systemic exposure, absorption or blood concentration.
modes.example: may increase the<< total>> systemic exposure to topical corticosteroids

modes.label: Space before a figure
modes.description: A blank space right before a large number in a news report about antibiotic use.

card.plain: It fires on the word just before a phrase about how much drug is absorbed or how big an amount is.
